subject: Post-call recap: Bindle Health — long-document fit & eval plan
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@bindlehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: Bindle Health — long-document fit & eval plan

Alex / Emma — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned. Great conversation; below is what we heard and what we recommend as an immediate eval path.

Summary of needs
- Primary workload: clinical visit notes + attachments (OCR text) per patient — average 4k–6k tokens, 95th percentile up to ~28k after concatenation of prior visits and labs.
- Goals: high-fidelity summarization for clinician handoff, entity extraction for billing codes, and minimal hallucination on medication names.
- Constraints: PHI cannot leave their VPC in raw form; initial eval will use synthetic/scrubbed dataset.

Redwood recommended eval plan (lightweight pilot)
1) Run a 200-document offline eval with three candidate configs:
   - rw-llamax-32k-v2 (32k context, FP16) — baseline for latency/cost tradeoff
   - rw-pegasus-64k-q4_0 (64k context, q4 quant) — higher-context variant for long summaries
   - rw-compat-32k-cache-optimized (32k w/ prefix/KV cache enabled) — cost-optimized path with caching
2) Metrics: summarization ROUGE-L + custom fidelity metric (see prompt set), extraction P/R/F1 for billing codes, truncation incidence rate, per-doc latency P50/P95.
3) Deliverables from Redwood within 10 business days of dataset receipt: evaluation report, per-model token cost estimate, example prompts and suggested caching/batching config.
4) Canary option: 7-day Dedicated canary (pilot) if offline results meet agreed fidelity thresholds.

Attachments I’m sending: call recording + prompt set v2 (contains the synthetic prompt scaffolds we discussed). I also attached an SLA draft for your procurement team to review so we can fast-follow.

Pricing high-level (ballpark for planning)
- Offline eval: covered by Redwood (no charge)
- Dedicated 7-day canary estimate: $8k–$12k depending on instance sizing and burst policy

Immediate asks
- Alex: please confirm whether you will provide a synthetic dataset or prefer Redwood to generate a scrubbed version from a subset.
- Emma: if procurement needs the SLA or a PO template, CC me and I’ll loop in our commercial team.
- Neha / Rishi: I’ve put you on notice to prepare the eval harness and the fidelity thresholds doc.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short follow-up to finalize the dataset transfer method.

—
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Jasmine — this is exactly the right level. Quick notes / clarifications from our side: 

- We will provide a synthetic dataset (team is generating a 250-doc set by EOD Friday) — do not use PHI.
- Two-week runway is preferable; can we compress the offline eval to 7 business days if we parallelize? Our procurement window is tight.
- Key acceptance: summarization must preserve medication names and dosage strings with >98% fidelity on the synthetic set. Truncation is our single biggest fear — we need explicit truncation reports per document.
- Security: we will need answers to our standard questionnaire (SOC2 scope + data retention controls). Please send the questionnaire link and a point contact for security.

Also: can you share cost delta between the 32k baseline and the 64k option assuming our 200-doc eval? That will help materially for internal approval.

Alex

Subject: RE: Post-call recap: Bindle Health — long-document fit & eval plan

Alex / Jasmine — thanks. I put together a concise tech plan + links below so the team can act quickly.

Eval artifacts (links)
- Benchmark folder (examples, scripts, result templates): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBc...bindle-eval
- Prompt set (attached): long_context_prompt_set_v2.jsonl — contains 12 prompt templates with positive/negative label guidance and hallucination probes.
- Eval harness (GitHub gist): https://gist.github.com/redwood/longdoc-eval-harness

Model recommendations and why
- rw-llamax-32k-v2: Lowest latency/cost while covering your median doc size. Good default for A/B baseline.
- rw-pegasus-64k-q4_0: Recommended if truncation > 3% in the 32k runs or if you need single-pass full-note summarization. Quantized option reduces token compute but increases latency a bit.
- rw-cache-32k-quickfall: For workloads with highly repetitive prefixes (patient header + standard forms) — KV caching reduces per-token de-dup cost by ~18% on similar corpora.

Suggested eval matrix (fast path; can be done in 7 business days if dataset and creds land today)
- Run: 200 docs x 3 models x 2 prompt variants (summary-long + summary-brief) = 1200 runs. Parallelize across 8 instances; estimated completion 3 days, then 2 days for metric aggregation and review.
- Metrics to compute: ROUGE-L, BLEU (extraction), custom fidelity checks for medications (regex match + manual spot check), truncation count, P50/P95 latency, and cost per doc.

Quality regression safeguards (important)
- Baseline: capture current model outputs (if you have any) to compute delta metrics.
- Regression alert: we’ll add a thresholded check so if medication fidelity drops below 98% or if hallucination probes increase >5% compared to baseline we flag and stop canary progression.

Prompt examples (excerpt)
- "Summarize the clinical encounter for handoff to a primary care physician. Preserve medication names and dosages. Output as: (1) one-paragraph summary, (2) bulleted meds with dose/frequency, (3) extraction of billing codes."
- Hallucination probe: "List any new medications introduced that are NOT in the medication section of the note."

Security & onboarding
- Jasmine: please send the security questionnaire link to Alex (I can answer technical items). Security contact: me (neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com).

Next steps / owners
- Bindle (Alex): deliver synthetic dataset link + expected delivery date (Alex indicated EOD Friday).
- Redwood (Neha): spin up eval harness and begin runs as soon as dataset is available.
- Redwood (Rishi): prepare Dedicated canary sizing & cost delta for 32k vs 64k. (Rishi — see attachment SLA for procurement).

Attaching: long_context_prompt_set_v2.jsonl (prompt scaffolds + expected labels).

-Neha
